---
name: Map Data Issue
about: Report missing nodes, incorrect connections, floor plan inaccuracies, or routing issues
title: '[MAP-DATA] '
labels: 'map-data'
assignees: ''
---

## Location & Floor Details
- **Building Name**: [e.g. Main Academic Block, Engineering Hall]
- **Floor**: [e.g. Ground Floor, Floor 1, Floor 2]
- **Map Name/ID**: [e.g. main_ground_floor]

## Specific Node / Edge Affected (If Known)
- **Node ID(s)**: [e.g. ElectricalEntry, MainRoad04, room102]
- **Edge ID(s)**: [e.g. edge_electrical_mainroad]

## Problem Description
Describe the mapping issue:
- [ ] Missing node (room, corridor, landmark, staircase, lift)
- [ ] Missing or incorrect edge connection between nodes
- [ ] Incorrect node coordinates $(X, Y)$ on SVG plan
- [ ] Inaccurate navigation route / step instruction
- [ ] SVG visual error or alignment issue

## Expected vs Current Path/Layout
Describe how the map or path should behave versus how it behaves currently.

## Reference Images / Maps
Attach floor plan photos, architectural sketches, or screenshots highlighting the area.
